claim: Apple's fiscal third-quarter 2026 revenue rose 16% year over year.
summary: Apple's fiscal Q3 2026 covers the quarter ending June 2026, which would be reported in late July/August 2026 — after the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04. Without tools, the claimed 16% year-over-year revenue increase cannot be verified.
